 welcome --> storeScreen
 welcome --> adminScreen

 userScreen --- auth
 storeScreen --- auth
 adminScreen --- auth
 auth --- backend
 end

 customer --> welcome
 operator --> welcome
 admin --> welcome
 backend --- database
